note: The designated camping area is at parking lot N, just north of Route D about 1 km west of Union Ridge Lake: a surfaced teardrop loop drive about 75 m long around a mown lawn with shade trees, with a privy and a disabled-accessible lot. No built pads; rigs park along the loop. No water. MDC also allows camping on or beside every other parking lot on the area (lots A-U, no amenities). --Claude
summary: Confirmed: one MDC-designated camping area with a loop drive and privy at lot N (map symbol + GIS point) - stays; no horse camp on the area; the other 18 lots are bare-lot camping, no split. Vault toilet written. Phone matches. Free/FCFS/14 nights/no hookups confirmed. Pin on the loop, no move.
flags: HOW MANY CAMPING AREAS: one designated. The 07/17 map legend has 'Primitive Camping Area' and uses the symbol once, at Parking Lot N on the north side of Route D west of Union Ridge Lake, together with the Privy and Disabled Accessible symbols; GIS layer 27 has one 'Primitive Camping Area' point at 40.32142,-92.86351, 43 m from the GIS lot point flagged ADA 'Yes'. The brochure (12/2021) adds: 'Camping is allowed on or adjacent to all area parking lots. No unattended open campfires allowed. No amenities are provided. ... Walk-in/backpack camping is allowed EXCEPT during firearms deer and turkey seasons.' The map letters 19-20 lots (A-U); GIS layer 26 has 19. None of the others has a camping symbol or anything built, so they are bare-lot camping and not split candidates (the split rule wants a built camp, not a lot).

BUILT CAMP: imagery (leaf-off, 0.33 m/px) at the GIS point shows a pale surfaced one-way loop (teardrop, about 75 x 45 m) off a short entrance drive from Route D, a mown lawn with several shade trees inside and around it, a small privy building with a pad on the loop's north-west side and a small lot at its east side. No individual pads, tables or rings can be made out; rigs would park on the loop or its edge. It is a designated camping area with a loop and a privy, not a ramp or parking lot, so it stays under the 2026-11-09 rules.
HORSE CAMP: none. Neither the page, the brochure nor the map mentions an equestrian camp or horse trails; the brochure says 'Bicycles and horses allowed on public roadways year-round.'

PIN: stored 40.32142,-92.86351 (GIS point) is on the lawn inside the loop. No move. (Esri's lower-zoom tiles are registered about 55 m off the high-zoom ones here; the 0.33 m/px frame is the one used.)
ACCESS: paved Route D to the entrance (2.5 miles north of Green Castle per the page); no ford, no posted limit, no 4WD wording.
WATER: not waterfront stands. Union Ridge Lake is about 1 km east (boat ramp, privy, lot E - no camping symbol there); Spring Creek is about 300 m south across Route D.
PHONE: stored 660-785-2420 matches the page's 'For more information call (660) 785-2420'.
Nothing else in the database within 6 km.
